subject: Solara Health MAP recalibration and reschedule request
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jason Liu <jason.liu@solarahealth.com>, Nadine Torres <nadine.torres@solarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Solara Health: MAP checkpoint — missed today?

Hi Jason / Nadine —

We missed our 10:00am PT MAP checkpoint today; hope everything is OK on your end. We had Marissa and Evelyn queued to review the next three milestones and validate the pilot acceptance criteria.

Quick ask: can you share whether you want to (a) rebook the checkpoint this week, or (b) push everything one sprint and we’ll send an updated MAP? I’ve attached the current MAP (Solara_MAP_v1.xlsx) so you can see the dates we reviewed previously.

If rebooking, here are two windows that work on our side:
- Wed 6/16, 11:00–11:30am PT
- Thu 6/17, 2:00–2:30pm PT

If your team prefers a MAP revision first, we can propose new milestone dates reflecting an expected timeline slip (engineering estimate: ~2 weeks) and highlight any downstream impacts to the pilot go-live. We’ll label that as Solara_MAP_v2 and share before the rescheduled checkpoint.

Either way, next step is a short 30-minute sync to confirm priorities. Please let me know which option works and who from your side will attend.

Thanks — sorry for the disruption, and we’ll make this flexible.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: Solara_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet of milestones)

From: Jason Liu <jason.liu@solarahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Nadine Torres <nadine.torres@solarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 20:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Solara Health: MAP checkpoint — missed today?

Hi Karthik —

Sorry — our VP had an unexpected escalation and we had to pull out last minute. My fault for not flagging earlier. Appreciate the nudge.

We’re leaning toward option (b): please send the updated MAP with adjusted milestone dates so we can circulate internally before we reconvene. High level: we still expect the pilot scope to hold, but there’s a potential constraint around our security review slot that may slide one additional week. If you can highlight any gating items for the security review (logs, audit proof points), that would help Nadine and I triage.

Proposed times for the reschedule from our side:
- Tue 6/22, 9:30–10:00am PT
- Wed 6/23, 3:00–3:30pm PT

Thanks — will review the v2 MAP when received.

—Jason
Jason Liu
Director, Product Integrations | Solara Health
jason.liu@solarahealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jason Liu <jason.liu@solarahealth.com>, Nadine Torres <nadine.torres@solarahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Solara Health: MAP recalibration and reschedule request

Thanks for the heads-up, Karthik — looping in a quick internal note before we send v2 to Solara.

Internal takeaways (short):
- Engineering flagged a likely 2-week delay to two milestones (model validation and infra hardening) if we need additional time for the security review.
- CS will mark pilot acceptance date as TBD until security window confirmed; recommend we call this out explicitly in v2.
- Action: Karhtik, can you send Solara a v2 with the revised dates + a 1-paragraph callout listing the documents they should prepare for the security review (audit logs, retention policy, SOC2 evidence)? I can then include acceptance criteria and updated owners.

I’ve drafted the spreadsheet updates into Solara_MAP_v2.xlsx (attached). I also created a reschedule invite for Tue 6/22 9:30am PT and attached the .ics; feel free to modify before sending.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Solara_MAP_v2.xlsx (draft), reschedule-invite.ics

From: Nadine Torres <nadine.torres@solarahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 18:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Solara Health: MAP recalibration and reschedule request

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the v2 draft, Marissa. We’ve reviewed and the revised dates look reasonable; the security slot pushed out one week is fine. We’ll be ready to review in the rescheduled checkpoint on Tue 6/22 at 9:30am PT — I’ve accepted the invite. Jason will also be on.

Nadine Torres
Head of Information Security, Solara Health
nadine.torres@solarahealth.com
